sn22.134:1.1: bārāṇasiyaṃ: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ mahākoṭṭhitaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.134:2.1: idhāvuso assutavā puthujjano rūpassa samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.134:2.5: viññāṇassa samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.134:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ mahākoṭṭhitaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.134:4.1: idhāvuso sutavā ariyasāvako rūpassa samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.134:4.5: viññāṇassa samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
